text:
maria: Starting prod roll for redwood/frontend v2026.04.02 but deploy-bot blocked in eu-west-1: provenance mismatch (missing blob). Holding. @sam @jen pls triage.

deploy-bot: publish blocked redwood/frontend:v2026.04.02 eu-west-1 error=ECR_PROVENANCE_MISSING_BLOB detail=manifest references blob sha256:aa11bb that returns 404

sam: On it. This smells like an incomplete cross-region replication for the linux/arm64 layer. I'll fetch manifests and check blob availability.

maria: Primary registry shows blob aa11bb present. eu returns 404 when pulling that blob.

jen: Given change window (ends 21:30 UTC) propose short-lived retag to v2026.04.02-eu-hotfix and push the manifest directly into eu to bypass replication. We'll cosign after push.

sam: Proposed steps: 1) batch-get-image from us-east, 2) put-image into eu with new tag, 3) cosign sign, 4) run eu canary. OK?

kai: OK but note: policy requires new attestation. Mark metadata as transient tag in the release record. Also update release notes BEFORE full rollout.

security: I'll monitor cosign audit. Do not promote hotfix tag until I ack signature validity.

sam: Running commands now:
```bash
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/frontend --image-ids imageTag=v2026.04.02 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' > m.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/frontend --image-tag v2026.04.02-eu-hotfix --image-manifest file://m.json --region eu-west-1
# cosign sign && upload attestations
```

deploy-bot: manual canary trigger accepted for redwood/frontend:v2026.04.02-eu-hotfix  status=in_progress

jen: Canary passed. eu registry now resolves blob aa11bb. cosign re-signed and attestations uploaded. Drafting a short release note about transient retag.

maria: Proceeding with full rollout. Deploybot initiating full rollout; auto-rollback target set to v2026.03.20 if error threshold exceeded. Monitor latency and 5xxs.

kai: Postmortem item: add a pre-push dest-blob-availability check to deploybot to fail fast and avoid mid-roll holds.

security: Acked signatures. You can reclaim the canonical tag after attestations verified.

maria: Hold cleared. Closing thread. Thanks.
